bio.text: Angus Purdy is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District in 2026.
In a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire he lists his occupation as front-of-house lead at Little Hat's Italian Market and a B.A. in history from Vanderbilt University.
In that questionnaire he says he ran for Metro Council in 2023, lives in Nashville, and grew up on a small farm in Spring Hill.

sources.title: Angus Purdy: Independent Candidate for Congress, District 6
